<thought>We have no existing data, so we need to retrieve polymorph data for up to 40 oxide compositions using the provided parameters (max_energy_above_hull=0.3, max_per_composition=3). We'll use the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool, saving the JSON files into a directory within the workspace.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "TiO2","SiO2","Al2O3","Fe2O3","FeO","Fe3O4","CuO","Cu2O","ZnO","MgO",
        "CaO","SrO","BaO","Na2O","K2O","PbO","PbO2","SnO2","SnO","Cr2O3",
        "CrO3","MnO2","Mn2O3","NiO","CoO","Co3O4","V2O5","MoO3","WO3","ZrO2",
        "HfO2","Ti2O3","Ti3O5","SiO","GeO2","GeO","Sb2O3","Sb2O5","Bi2O3"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_oxides_trial_3/oxides_data"
}
</action_input>
